settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Wet the bar and your hair, then glide it over your scalp and lengths until you see lather. Work it in, rinse well and follow with a conditioner bar. Pro tip: keep the bar in a mesh bag so it dries between showers.

settings.label: Hero ingredients
settings.text: Rice protein reinforces each strand, panthenol draws in water for softness, and a mild coconut-derived cleanser lifts oil without stripping.

settings.label: Full ingredient list

settings.text: Most people notice cleaner roots in the first wash and fuller-looking hair after a few weeks.

settings.label: Is it right for every hair type?
settings.text: Yes for most. If your hair is very porous or protein-sensitive, alternate it with a protein-free formula.

settings.label: How much should I use?
